option.name: originalContent
option.value:
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS base
# Install Python, LibreOffice, and system dependencies for document processing RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \ python3 \ python3-pip \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Install common document processing Python libraries RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages
WORKDIR /app EXPOSE 8088 ENV ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://+:8088 ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/skills
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build WORKDIR /src COPY . . RUN dotnet restore RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app/publish
FROM base AS final WORKDIR /app COPY --from=build /app/publish .
# Copy skills packages into the container (sourced from src/agent/skills/ in the build context) COPY --from=build /src/skills ./skills
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "FoundryDiagnosisAgent.Agent.dll"]

FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS base
# Install Python and network diagnostics tooling (TCP-first, ICMP-optional) RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \ python3 \ python3-pip \ ca-certificates \ curl \ dnsutils \ iproute2 \ iputils-ping \ mtr-tiny \ net-tools \ netcat-openbsd \ nmap \ tcpdump \ tcptraceroute \ traceroute \ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Install Python libraries for diagnostics, analysis, and chart output RUN python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages \ dnspython \ httpx \ matplotlib \ netaddr \ networkx \ numpy \ pandas \ plotly \ python-nmap \ requests \ rich \ scapy \ seaborn \ tabulate
WORKDIR /app EXPOSE 8088 ENV ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://+:8088 ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/skills
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build WORKDIR /src COPY . . RUN dotnet restore RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app/publish
FROM base AS final WORKDIR /app COPY --from=build /app/publish .
# Copy skills packages into the container (sourced from src/agent/skills/ in the build context) COPY --from=build /src/skills ./skills
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "FoundryDiagnosisAgent.Agent.dll"]
